files.reason: Extracts the existing logo-card URL construction into a shared helper. Existing restaurant and item preview selection, image URLs, backgrounds and error handling remain identical; their regression tests pass. The new receipt/confirmation consumers are documented separately in both public guides.

impact.behavior: Receipt and order-confirmation link previews use the concerned restaurant name and logo. Receipt identity is resolved from its authorized token. No customer or order details enter social metadata; noindex/nofollow is preserved. A restaurant without a logo gets a name card.

validation.web: 21 targeted metadata/OG regressions, TypeScript, lint and production build passed. Existing lint warnings only.
validation.renderedPages: 10 synthetic WhatsApp/Facebook HTML cases passed: multiple restaurants, no logo, unavailable public restaurant with receipt fallback, invalid receipt, missing/ambiguous confirmation restaurant, spoofed receipt restaurant query, no private metadata and one receipt fetch per render.
validation.landing: check:help, 26 help tests, source/documentation contracts, lint, TypeScript and production build passed.

publication.status: Development deployment and subsequent production promotion authorized by the user.
publication.strategy: Merge each required PR into develop, verify its immutable development artifact, then promote the same artifact without rebuilding. Keep production auto-assignment disabled.
